derivation: from G303 (ἀνά) (in the sense of reversal) and G2955 (κύπτω);
def: to unbend, i.e. rise; figuratively, be elated

occurrences.text: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.
So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.
When Jesus had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
